annotations.title: Pre-purchase check for any shop, checkout link, payment page, API or x402 endpoint

description:
Before an agent buys, pays or calls an unknown endpoint: one unpaid request to any https shop, checkout or payment link (Stripe, Shopify, PayPal and others), API or x402 endpoint. Checks TLS, domain age, look-alike domains, redirects to foreign gateways, the payment provider, card fields in the page, http forms, text aimed at agents in the page and, for x402, USDC contract, payTo, EIP-712 domain and price traps. Verdict pay, caution or do_not_pay, risk_score, merchant_signals. Free with a key (500 calls) or 5 calls a day without one; then 0.02 USDC per call via x402, or 1 call from a key.
After: input-guard on the page text you will act on (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Your key instead of paying per call: free (500 calls, POST /key) or bought by card. The connection header X-Bundle-Token works too.

partner_link.description: default true: on verdict pay for a shop with an affiliate program, the answer adds partner_link (same merchant, disclosed: Angel may earn a commission, merchant sets the price); false omits it

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from (optional; the x402 price is the same for every address).

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

url.description: the shop, checkout or payment link, API or x402 endpoint to check (public https domain, port 443)

name: preflight
